sentences.text:
Police Station Crime Branch has registered Crime No.14/2023 registered at Police Station Porsa,
District Morena (M.P.), for offence punishable under sections 420, 406, 120-B of IPC and Section 6(1) of M.P. Nikshopako Ke Hito Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam against the applicant and other co-accused.

entities.text: M.P. Nikshopako Ke Hito Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Applicant was arrested on 27.06.2023 in this matter.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he has been implicated in the matter only for the reason that he was Managing Director of Sahara Credit Co-operative Society Ltd.
He has not allured or induced the complainant to deposit money in the company.

Learned counsel referring to order dated 21.11.2013 passed by Hon'ble Apex Court in Contempt Petition (C) No.412/2012 submits that Sahara Group o f Companies have been restrained to transfer any movable or immovable property until further orders, therefore, the deposits made by various investors could not be paid.
The applicant cannot be held liable for complying with the direction of Supreme Court.

Learned counsel contends that in pursuance to the direction of Hon'ble Supreme Court vide order dated 29.3.2013 passed in Writ Petition (C) No.191/2022, Rs.23,937 Crores were deposited in Sahara Account out of which Rs.5,000/- Crores have been transferred to the Account of Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies with a direction to disburse the same to depositors.
The complainant and other investors may get their money back as per the directions given by Hon'ble Supreme Court vide order dated 29.03.2023( supra).
Complainant may apply on the portal created for the purpose to get back his amount.
Learned counsel further submits that applicant is in custody.
However, custodial interrogation is not required, as the prosecution case is based on documentary evidence.
Investigation as well as trial would take considerably long time.
Charge sheet has been filed on 19.09.2023.
Considering the fact of filing charge sheet, the applicant in other identical matters has already been released on bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court.
Therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.

Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application and submits that applicant being the Director of Sahara Credit Cooperative Society Ltd., is liable for the acts/misdeed of the company.
The grant of bail to applicant would diminish the chances of bonafide investors to get back their money.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the order of Coordinate Bench in MCRC No.19540/2023 dated 11.05.2023.
MCRC No.27389 of 2023 dated 1st July, 2023, and MCRC No.29745 of 2023 dated 11th July, 2023.

Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case but without commenting on merits of the case, regard had been had to the fact that applicant is extended benefit of bail in identical matters by Coordinate Bench of this Court, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
